ī: This, this, this letter. This - vowel. Of the forty-one letters and eight vowels, the fourth is the consonant, which is the basis of the thirty-two consonants, except for the one pronounced (Tuluza) in Asok. Tipi, 4a, 620 ī This (1) This-element. (2) This-substance. (3) This-Vibhata. (4) this -Āguṃ.. (5) this which is deviated from other letter,( Ādesa-this).Tipi,4A,620 ī ī(thī) [a+ī. Vi,pi,dhāna] (1) the male deity called Lakkhī.  (2) Kind words. Look at him.
